significance: A Shiva temple near Vishnampettai in Thanjavur district, one of the Padal Petra Sthalams, praised in the hymns of Sambandar and Thirunavukkarasar. Tradition links its building to the Chola king Karikala.
story: Parasurama is said to have worshipped Shiva here to be freed of the sin of killing the Kshatriyas.
